title: TWITTER Gravel V3 WheelTop EDS TX 2x12
notes: Exact regional WheelTop EDS TX 2x12 build page identifies a high-modulus carbon frame and fork, internal routing, integrated carbon cockpit, T47, hidden seatpost clamp, and approximately 9.9 kg complete weight with size, pedal, accessory and weighing basis unstated. The selected Holographic / L (54 cm) option is US$1,750; this is not a mainland-China price. No frame-only weight or meaningful stiffness test is published.
